iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 41 of US-Israel war on Iran (since Feb 28 2026). Bushehr nuclear plant struck Apr 4-5 — projectile killed one guard, side building damaged. WHO warns 'catastrophic' radiological risk. IAEA provides update on Natanz/Fordow. Trump ultimatum: destroy 'every power plant' by Apr 8 deadline. Iran rejected 45-day ceasefire proposal. Enrichment continues at ~60%. Technical: CRITICAL | Rhetoric: HIGH | Mobilization: HIGH

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 41. US-Israel strikes continued Apr 7 hitting Tehran as Hormuz deadline looms. Trump threatened to destroy all Iranian bridges and power plants. Iran hit Jebel Ali (UAE) — a key regional hub. Strait of Hormuz under imminent threat. Pezeshkian rejected ceasefire. Iranian retaliations ongoing across Gulf bases. Cyber warfare escalating.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Hezbollah pauses attacks under US-Iran ceasefire framework (Apr 8). However, Israel continues ground invasion of southern Lebanon — 1.2M displaced, towns destroyed. Ain Saadeh strike (Apr 5) killed civilians outside Hezbollah zone. Ground operations expanding. Humanitarian crisis deepening. Ceasefire fragile.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: FM Fidan reiterated Turkey could be pulled into nuclear arms race if Iran acquires weapons. Akkuyu NPP commissioning 2026 on track. NATO B61-12 replacement at Incirlik ongoing. No new escalation signals. Strategic ambiguity maintained.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: CFR report: armed conflict India-Pakistan likely 2026 due to Kashmir. Operation Sindoor (May 2025) precedent set. Both nuclear-armed states continuing buildup. US intel warns nuclear conflict possible. No new escalation Apr 8.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026. Secretary Rubio slammed door on bilateral arms control. Russia standing with Iran — warned US-Israel on nuclear facility targeting. Ongoing Russia-Ukraine war drives nuclear signaling. No replacement treaty in sight.

china.name: China
china.notes: ISW/AEI Apr 3 2026: No significant PLA activity changes. Taiwan Strait stable. KMT delegation visiting China. Trump admin focused on Iran — may reduce Beijing's Taiwan pressure appetite. US intel maintains 2027 invasion unlikely.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: DPRK declared nuclear status 'irreversible' Apr 7 2026 — constitutional mandate. Multiple ballistic missiles fired Apr 7 — second launch in 2 days. KN-14 solid ICBM: operational. Submarine missile test IMMINENT (maintenance complete). Kim Jong Un observed 600mm rocket tests with daughter Kim Ju Ae. Warship cruise missile tests ongoing. Kim demands US nuclear recognition as precondition for talks.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4. ISW Offensive Campaign Assessments Apr 1-5 2026. GCRI: nuclear escalation risk elevated if Russia perceives failure. IISS: 'escalation not stalemate' — unstable equilibrium driving escalation. Russian disinformation about Ukrainian bombs (Apr 2026). Hybrid warfare intensifying. NATO support sustained.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: China-mediated talks underway in Urumqi (Apr 2). Pakistan and Afghanistan confirm ceasefire negotiations. TTP safe haven issue remains flashpoint. UN experts challenged Pakistan's TTP attribution. Diplomatic track active — slight de-escalation signal. Open war declared Feb 27, now in mediation phase.
